Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — appreciate you walking us through Acme Health's intake flow and the goals you mentioned (reduce triage latency, improve classification accuracy for eligibility). Quick recap and next steps: 

- Scope: ingest + classification for new patient intake forms (English only, pilot 2 clinics)
- Success metrics: 90%+ classification accuracy on priority labels, avg latency < 300ms per request
- Redwood deliverables for POC: hosted sandbox with example dataset, onboarding checklist, SSO + security docs, and a 2-week evaluation window

Action items:
1) I attached the Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx and the current Statement_of_Work_v1.pdf for your review.
2) Proposed kickoff windows: Dec 7–9 or Dec 14–16 (we can be flexible). Rafael (CC) will handle environment setup and SSO options.
3) Please confirm which window works and who from your side will be the technical point of contact.

If it helps, I can also schedule a 30-minute kickoff with Rafael + Aditya to walk through onboarding steps.

Thanks — excited to get things moving.

Best,
